# Finman

Finman is an AI-powered personal finance manager for individuals and families.

## Product
- URL: https://finman.money
- Type: SaaS web app + native Android and iOS mobile apps (Capacitor)
- Pricing: Free tier, Pro ($9.99/month), Family ($19.99/month)

## Features
- AI CFO Chat: conversational financial advisor powered by Claude, GPT-4, or Gemini; reads user's actual transaction data
- Auto-categorize transactions: ML-based categorization that learns from corrections
- Receipt scanning: vision AI extracts merchant, amount, date, line items from receipt photos
- Budget planner: category budgets with real-time tracking and proactive alerts
- Investment tracker: stocks, ETFs, crypto, alternatives with performance analysis
- Net worth dashboard: automatic daily calculation from connected accounts
- Debt payoff optimizer: avalanche, snowball, and AI-hybrid strategies
- Subscription tracker: automatic detection of recurring charges
- Financial forecasting: AI-powered 3/6/12-month cash flow projections
- Family finance: up to 6 members, shared budgets, split expenses, privacy controls
- Savings goals, recurring payments, bill calendar, analytics, reports, bank API integration
- Split expenses, multi-currency, export

## AI Stack
- AI providers: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4, Google Gemini (configurable via AI_PROVIDER env)
- Vision AI for receipt scanning
- ML for transaction categorization

## Tech Stack
- Backend: Node.js / Express
- Database: SQLite
- Frontend: Vanilla JS SPA
- Mobile: Capacitor (Android + iOS)

## Marketing Pages
- Landing: https://finman.money/marketing/
- Features: https://finman.money/marketing/features/
- Blog: https://finman.money/marketing/blog/
- Finman vs Mint: https://finman.money/marketing/compare/finman-vs-mint/
- Finman vs YNAB: https://finman.money/marketing/compare/finman-vs-ynab/

## Target Audience
Individuals, families, small business owners managing personal finances. Former Mint users looking for an AI-powered alternative. YNAB users who find zero-based budgeting too time-intensive.
